name: Unadilla MX

soil.notes: Hard-packed, historically rocky base. Topsoil was reintroduced around 2013, which made it rut; rocks have been cleared over time but 450 roost still throws them.

layout.notes: Valley track with most sections cambered so riders live on the tire edge. The Wall climb rewards the right line at the bottom.

conditions.dry: On a sunny day it gets very tricky late; traction varies across the track.
conditions.wet: Rain the day before soaked topsoil layers and made it rutty but more grippy than the usual hard surface.
conditions.late_day: Ruts deepen, especially on the downhill approaches; rear wheel climbing a rut wall loses grip.
conditions.seasonal: Pro national each August (39th in 2025); amateur days around it.

rider_reports.says: Analyst: known for hardpack; Friday rain softened it into rutty but grippier conditions; float over bumps instead of attacking; standing through turns and patient riding won.
Analyst: topsoil added about a decade ago created the ruts; stay in the middle of ruts, brake less, keep momentum, small smooth inputs; rocks break visors and plates.
Local TV coverage: riders describe a hard-pack, rutty surface.
